q: What was the golden goal rule, used in the 1990s and scrapped in 2004?
a: The first goal in extra time ended the match at once
note: Golden goal ended the game immediately; abolished after Euro 2004.

q: In a two-legged tie, what does 'on aggregate' mean?
a: The two legs' goals added together
note: Aggregate is the combined score over both legs.

q: Which official on the touchline signals substitutions and the amount of added time?
note: The fourth official handles the board on the touchline.

q: What is a goal scored straight from a corner kick commonly called?
note: Gol olimpico / Olympic goal is the standard name for a direct corner.

q: What is the second tier of German football called?
note: 2. Bundesliga is the German second tier.

q: Which continent's confederation is CONCACAF?
a: North and Central America and the Caribbean
note: CONCACAF covers North and Central America and the Caribbean.

q: In which country does UEFA have its headquarters?
note: UEFA is based in Nyon, Switzerland.

q: Which country won the 2011 Women's World Cup?
note: Japan beat the USA on penalties in the 2011 final.

q: Which country hosted the 1962 World Cup?
note: Chile hosted in 1962.

q: The 'Miracle of Bern' describes which country's World Cup final win?
note: West Germany beat Hungary 3-2 in Bern, 1954.

q: Which country lost the 1954 World Cup final despite being unbeaten for four years?
note: Hungary's unbeaten run of 31 games ended in that final.

q: Which American club did Pelé join in 1975?
note: Pele joined the New York Cosmos in 1975.

q: Which Dutch midfielder joined Pelé's old club New York Cosmos in 1979?
note: Neeskens joined the Cosmos in 1979.

q: Which London club did Jürgen Klinsmann play for in the 1990s?
note: Klinsmann played for Spurs in 1994-95 and again in 1997-98.

q: Which country did Jürgen Klinsmann manage at the 2006 World Cup?
note: Klinsmann managed Germany at the 2006 World Cup.

q: Which country did Marcelo Bielsa manage at the 2010 World Cup?
note: Bielsa managed Chile in 2010.

q: Which Portuguese club did José Mourinho win the UEFA Cup with in 2003?
note: Porto beat Celtic in the 2003 UEFA Cup final.

q: Which Italian club did José Mourinho take charge of in 2021?
note: Mourinho took the Roma job in 2021.

q: Which trophy did Roma win in 2022, the first season it was played for?
note: Roma won the first Europa Conference League in 2022.

q: Which country did Roberto Mancini manage to the Euro 2020 title?
note: Mancini's Italy won Euro 2020.

q: Which national team did Fabio Capello manage from 2008 to 2012?
note: Capello managed England 2008-2012.
